messages:
Lina P.: Hey team — got an e-invoice (UBL) from Thessaloniki Systems for March usage (invoice TS-2026-03). Their VAT in the XML looks different from the VAT we have on file. Snippet below. Should we hold payment or ask for a corrected e-invoice?

Maria T.: paste the VAT string pls. Is it prefixed with EL? Greece VAT usually uses EL in VIES.

Lina P.: here's the exact XML snippet they sent:
```xml
<Invoice>
  <Seller>
    <VATNumber>999999999</VATNumber>
    <Country>GR</Country>
  </Seller>
  <InvoiceNo>TS-2026-03</InvoiceNo>
  <Amount currency="EUR">12450.00</Amount>
</Invoice>
```

Oliver K.: Looks like vendor omitted the country prefix. If we try VIES, we need EL999999999. I ran a quick check and EL999999999 returns inactive in VIES (no match). Could be a local registration number or typo.

Maria T.: If the VAT is inactive, we cannot treat this as intra-EU B2B reverse-charge. Two options: 1) ask vendor to confirm VAT and provide proof (gov portal printout) or reissue invoice with a valid VAT; 2) if they are domestic supplier, they must add VAT to the invoice. We shouldn't self-gross-up without vendor documentation.

Sam F.: Agreed. Operationally, we'll place payment on hold and request corrected e-invoice + VAT proof. Can someone confirm AP status so we flag it? I'll draft the vendor message and set a 3-business-day SLA.

AP-bot: Payment hold flag set on invoice TS-2026-03 — reason: VAT validation mismatch. Notified AP queue.

Lina P.: Thanks. Vendor is asking for expedited payment due to project delays. We'll share the hold reason and request the corrected UBL/PEPPOL file. Sam, can you send the template?

Sam F.: Yep — draft below. Feel free to copy: 
"Hi Thessaloniki Systems — thanks for the invoice. Our finance team found a VAT/registration mismatch for invoice TS-2026-03. To proceed we need either (A) a reissued e-invoice (UBL/PEPPOL) that includes your EU VAT number in the format 'EL#########' and matches your vendor record, or (B) a scanned copy of the Greek tax registry/VAT activation showing the VAT number. Please reissue within 3 business days. Payment will remain on hold until we receive valid documentation. If you are a domestic supplier charging Greek VAT, please include the VAT line and total.
Kind regards, Sam on behalf of Redwood Inference AP"

Maria T.: I'll also ask our tax advisor to run a quick lookup in the Greek tax portal in case VIES lagging. But hold is correct for now.

Oliver K.: Noted. I've added a quick note in the vendor record: "Awaiting corrected VAT / e-invoice - payment on hold".

Lina P.: OK — closing loop here. Sam please post the outbound message in replies when sent. I'll ping product if vendor claims SLA penalties.

Sam F.: Will do. Posting the message to vendor now and cc'ing vendor contact.

AP-bot: Vendor message posted to vendor-email@example.com at 2026-03-18T15:12:03Z.

Lina P.: Closing for now — reopen thread if vendor returns corrected docs or pushes back. :white_check_mark:
